title: The Astragalus Membranaceus Herb Attenuates Leukemia by Inhibiting the FLI1 Oncogene and Enhancing Anti-Tumor Immunity.
authors: Yu, Kunlin; Tang, Yao; Wang, Chunlin; Liu, Wuling; Hu, Maoting; Hu, Anling; Kuang, Yi; Zacksenhaus, Eldad; Yu, Xue-Zhong; Xiao, Xiao; Ben-David, Yaacov
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪成分抑制白血病，涉及化合物与FLI1蛋白的分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Astragalus membranaceus (AM) herb is a component of traditional Chinese medicine used to treat various cancers. Herein, we demonstrate a strong anti-leukemic effect of AM injected (Ai) into the mouse model of erythroleukemia induced by Friend virus. Chemical analysis combined with mass spectrometry of AM/Ai identified the compounds Betulinic acid, Kaempferol, Hederagenin, and formononetin, all major mediators of leukemia inhibition in culture and in vivo. Docking analysis demonstrated binding of these four compounds to FLI1, resulting in downregulation of its targets, induction of apoptosis, differentiation, and suppression of cell proliferation. Chemical composition analysis identified other compounds previously known having anti-tumor activity independent of the FLI1 blockade. Among these, Astragaloside-A (As-A) has marginal effect on cells in culture, but strongly inhibits leukemogenesis in vivo, likely through improvement of anti-tumor immunity. Indeed, both IDO1 and TDO2 were identified as targets of As-A, leading to suppression of tryptophane-mediated Kyn production and leukemia suppression. Moreover, As-A interacts with histamine decarboxylase (HDC), leading to suppression of anti-inflammatory genes TNF, IL1B/IL1A, TNFAIP3, and CXCR2, but not IL6. These results implicate HDC as a novel immune checkpoint mediator, induced in the tumor microenvironment to promote leukemia. Functional analysis of AM components may allow development of combination therapy with optimal anti-leukemia effect.
abstract_zh: 黄芪（Astragalus membranaceus, AM）是用于治疗多种癌症的传统中药成分之一。在此，我们证明了将AM注射（Ai）至Friend病毒诱导的红白血病小鼠模型中，具有显著的抗白血病效果。结合质谱分析的化学分析鉴定出AM/Ai中的化合物桦木酸（Betulinic acid）、山柰酚（Kaempferol）、常春藤皂苷元（Hederagenin）和芒柄花素（formononetin），这些均为在培养和体内抑制白血病的主要介质。对接分析表明，这四种化合物与FLI1结合，导致其靶标下调、诱导凋亡、分化以及抑制细胞增殖。化学成分分析还鉴定出其他已知具有独立于FLI1阻断的抗肿瘤活性的化合物。其中，黄芪甲苷-A（Astragaloside-A, As-A）对培养细胞影响甚微，但在体内强烈抑制白血病发生，可能通过改善抗肿瘤免疫实现。确实，IDO1和TDO2被鉴定为As-A的靶标，导致色氨酸介导的犬尿氨酸（Kyn）产生受抑及白血病抑制。此外，As-A与组氨酸脱羧酶（HDC）相互作用，导致抗炎基因TNF、IL1B/IL1A、TNFAIP3和CXCR2（而非IL6）的表达受抑。这些结果表明HDC是一种新型免疫检查点介质，在肿瘤微环境中被诱导以促进白血病。对AM成分的功能分析可能有助于开发具有最佳抗白血病效果的联合疗法。
